notes.title: Check out this Japanese supergamer playing Mow That Lawn
notes.content:
I recently discovered that a skilled Japanese shoot-'em-up specialist played Mow That Lawn and streamed it on YouTube.

Unfortunately, he encountered quite a few bugs during the game, but he managed to overcome them all and complete it. After coming across the video, I made an effort to fix those issues.

Check out his impressive playthrough here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=coljH10q6Lc&t=11496s

- Kristoffer, developer of Mow That Lawn.
